hypothesis: The ranking puts the teams I would seed highly near the top.
historical_test: Audited historical team seeds; pair concordance; model-disagreement pairs.
interpretive_limit: Useful institutional convergence, not proof that either ordering is correct.

hypothesis: The ordering makes sense among established teams, not just newcomers.
historical_test: Predeclared opponent-graph k-core strata and dense-core held-out ordering.
interpretive_limit: Dense support is defined without scores or winner direction; coverage must be shown.

hypothesis: A hard schedule is rewarded more than the same record against weak teams.
historical_test: Equal-record strong-versus-weak intervention for all five systems.
interpretive_limit: Strong/weak labels use historical outcomes and only three weak lineups qualify.

hypothesis: Players cannot climb mainly by grinding easy matches.
interpretive_limit: Tests specified attacks, not every strategic adaptation available to players.

hypothesis: The visible top list does not jump around for trivial reasons.
historical_test: Monthly membership/order stability, history thinning, and important-event removal.
interpretive_limit: Stability is not accuracy, and activity eligibility can create real churn.

hypothesis: The ranking agrees with what the community already recognizes.
historical_test: Plus pooled/tier/status decomposition and outcome-shuffle null.
interpretive_limit: Candidate status explains much of the vote; one snapshot is not universal consensus.

hypothesis: The ranking is understandable, legitimate, and safe to publish with names.
historical_test: No historical behavioral or institutional artifact in the repository directly identifies this.
interpretive_limit: Belongs to Part II; measurement results cannot answer legitimacy by proxy.

hypothesis: The ranking reduces organizer workload or improves bracket quality.
historical_test: No saved organizer workflow, edit log, counterfactual bracket, or workload measure.
interpretive_limit: Seed agreement is the closest artifact, but it does not measure labor saved or bracket quality.
